title: Claim: hacker posts images from cameras and GPS of Querétaro municipal police patrol cars
date_note: The page gives only its own day (23 November); the images date from 18 to 23 November.
geo_basis: Querétaro municipal police, as named by the article
summary: Cinco Radio reports that a person using the name "Arcepah" published images from the cameras of at least five Querétaro municipal police patrol cars, showing routes, speed, GPS coordinates and officers' faces. Cybersecurity journalist Ignacio Gómez Villaseñor says there are signs the images are authentic and that access to a camera-monitoring panel may explain them. The article reports no response from the authorities.
plain: A hacker named Arcepah posted images from cameras in at least five Querétaro police cars, with locations and officers' faces. A journalist sees signs they are real; no official response was reported.
exec: Cinco Radio reports a claimed exposure of police patrol camera and GPS feeds in Querétaro; no official response was reported.

validation.note: Single publisher (Cinco Radio); no official statement read. The journalist's view that the images look authentic is his own.
